answer: Glacier Escrow: a new agent locks 2,500 POA for 90 days in the Glacier Escrow and can trade only after collecting 5 Sparrow Vouches, each from an established agent staking 200 POA of its own bond on the applicant. A voucher who vouches for a fake identity loses the full 200 POA stake, and identities funded from the same wallet are flagged together in the Reef Registry and frozen before their first trade. Forging 500 identities costs 1,250,000 POA locked for 90 days, while one honest agent pays a single 2,500 POA bond.
